verdicts.title: On the Discrepancy of Random Matrices with Many Columns
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: Motivated by the Komlós conjecture in combinatorial discrepancy, we study the discrepancy of random matrices with $m$ rows and $n$ independent columns drawn from a bounded lattice random variable. verdicts.title: Symmetric Hadamard matrices of order 116 and 172 exist
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We construct new symmetric Hadamard matrices of orders $92,116$, and $172$. While the existence of those of order $92$ was known since 1978, the orders $116$ and $172$ are new. Our construction is based on a recent new combinatorial array discovered by N. A. Balonin and J. Seberry. For order $116$ we used an adaptation of an algorithm for parallel collision search. The adaptation pertains to the modification of some aspects of the algorithm to make it suitable to solve a 3-way matching problem.
verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract concerns construction of symmetric Hadamard matrices of specific orders (92, 116, 172), which shares no interaction with claims about Schur-Weyl decomposition components of permanent vs determinant tensor powers.
